en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a pastoral scene with a large tree-lined meadow, a horse grazing in the distance, and several people (adults and children) walking or standing in the field. On the right is a small white cottage with a thatched roof at the edge of a wooded area. A narrow path curves from the foreground toward the cottage. The caption in Dutch is printed below the image within a white border.
